descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S01 Existing specs: Hospital edit → Copy to EMR copies the saved edit and each toggle shows only its own data; the Nursing Home note and tasks can be edited; the billing card shows on Post-Round for every code family

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The Note / Tasks / Meds toggle shows only one section at a time, and each section shows its own correct content (the three views hold correct, independent data). (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 2; TFA-92595 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U3 After editing the note, 'Copy to EMR' copies the current edited text to the clipboard (a clipboard copy only). (UAT TC-17; TFA-92595 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T7 The Note tab shows tomorrow's Pre-Round summary underneath the note. (TFA-92595 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • U9 Both modes (ground rule 3.3): TC-17 does not say Hospital-only, so every outcome above must hold in Hospital and in Nursing Home. The ticket has no Hospital/Nursing Home AC (Q3). (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-17) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T3 The Billing Suggestion appears on the Note tab, alongside (below) the note. (TFA-92595 AC 6; TFA-92595 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Tim's fixtures: a Hospital patient in note-ready with a generated note, one open task, one changed medication and a course line that becomes tomorrow's summary; a Nursing Home resident with a note and one task; four Hospital patients and two residents with generated notes (mocked suggestBilling)

When Hospital Post-Round → Edit Note → replace the text → Save Edits → Copy to EMR (async clipboard API, then the textarea fallback an embedded EMR browser uses); edit Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary; switch to meds and tasks; edit, flag and delete the task; reload. …

Then Both clipboard paths hold exactly the edited note and the line 'Note copied to clipboard — paste into your EMR.' shows; the Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary heading is visible on the note toggle and its edit survives the reload; meds shows the medication and neither the note nor the task; tasks shows the task and neither the note nor the medication. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions (the clipboard read back with clipboard-read permission; a database read of the course line). Not asserted: that the summary sits under the note, or the billing card below the note and absent on Tasks/Meds (ordering is left to S22's manual parity review). One edit then one copy: the re-edit → re-copy of UAT step 5 is S02; …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-17/S01

Existing specs: Hospital edit → Copy to EMR copies the saved edit and each toggle shows only its own data; the Nursing Home note and tasks can be edited; the billing card shows on Post-Round for every code family

Tickets: TFA-92595 Post-Round Review & Completion (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-17.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • billing-suggestion.spec.ts [chromium] — the visible card shows each Hospital and Nursing Home code family — expected
  • longitudinal-workflows.spec.ts [chromium] — the SNF note and task list can be edited from post-round — expected
  • rounding-workflows.spec.ts [chromium] — the post-round note and task controls remain fully editable — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs (chromium), which create and seed fresh @roundai.test accounts through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and one shared account (runner-contract §10), so this runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
